document_semantics: Freeze one complete validated Document v2 through evaluator.FreezeSnapshot without claiming backend capabilities. Index only enabled Text-track clips and bind every request to the exact canonical DocumentHash, IDs, indexes, immutable text identities and visible time mapping.
binding_semantics: Require an explicit DocumentHash plus FontAssetID to live ShapeProvider authorization for every distinct font used by enabled Text assets. Duplicate, missing, extra, cross-document, wrong-ID and wrong-content bindings fail; equal font hashes never create an implicit authorization edge.
static_subset_semantics: Accept only cutly.text.pinned-font-viewport-px.v2 with its frozen static fill. Reject every text.fill keyframe lane, every nonzero transition involving a Text track, legacy text, unsupported profiles and affects-rendering extension properties. Transform, crop and opacity remain compositor responsibilities.
request_semantics: Require the exact frozen timeline/track/clip/asset scope; binding, semantic, layout and font identities; viewport; profile chain; and evaluator-equivalent timeline, local and source times inside the clip's half-open visible interval.
response_semantics: Echo the complete Request and return only a provider-owned immutable intrinsic Surface, the provider-authenticated textassembly receipt, static-raster receipt and independently rechecked canonical pixel identity.
manifest_semantics: Return a defensive AssetID-sorted list with exactly one derivation record per distinct enabled Text asset. Multiple clips referencing one asset share one immutable cached surface; no cross-AssetID hash deduplication occurs.
resource_semantics: Bound bindings, clip scopes, text/font assets, tracks, complete document nodes and canonical bytes before source binding. Pre-admit the overflow-checked sum of width*height*8 cached surfaces; each frozen-source, assembly and raster stage has explicit nested limits; total compile working evidence is checked without retaining temporary trust roots.
cancellation_semantics: Check a non-nil context before and throughout freezing, indexing, authorization, every sequential bind/assemble/raster/hash stage, request validation and publication. Cancellation discards all local state and returns nil Provider or a zero Frame.
ownership_semantics: Compile borrows Document and ShapeProvider values only until return. A successful Provider retains value-only clip scopes and receipts plus immutable Surfaces; it retains no font provider, FrozenTextSource, textassembly.Source, layout, outline, shaped stream, raw font bytes, maps supplied by callers or mutable cache.
failure_semantics: Invalid document, subset, binding, profile, request, resource, child receipt, surface identity, cancellation or panic fails closed. Compile returns no partial Provider and Frame returns a strictly zero value on failure.
excluded_responsibilities: Dynamic text paint, rich text, fallback/system fonts, bidi inference, transitions, transform/crop/opacity composition, output color conversion, encoding, signing, scheduling, persistence and publication are outside this provider.
